programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Hopes And Dreams

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Date Rape
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey are at odds over the investigation of a rape case. Cagney sides with the male investigators who feel the woman is at fault, while Lacey sides with the woman. Things become more complicated when the woman's past is used against her.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Burn-Out

programme.desc: Detective Victor Isbecki's cover is blown during an investigation of a dangerous car theft ring and he becomes a hostage. Cagney and Lacey must work to help save him while coming to terms with their own failures in the investigation.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Let Them Eat Pretzels

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: The Gang's All There

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Cry For Help
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey are assigned to investigate a wife-beating case and discover that the victim's husband is a cop and former classmate of Lacey's. Meanwhile the team also has to find a way to charge a con man after they are forced to let him go.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: The Informant

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Matinee

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Mind Hunters
programme.desc: Psychological Profiling: Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares, and in the minds of serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid the box exploded killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: To the astute detective and forensic specialist, the biggest clues often hide in plain sight, and what seems trivial to some is in reality Critical Evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Psychological Profiling: Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares and in the minds of serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Formed in the 1830s to protect settlers against Indian attack, the Rangers became part of the Texas Highway Patrol in 1935. Their role has continued to evolve to keep up with changing times; today it includes sophisticated forensics labs.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce  with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: April a une conduite de plus en plus étrange. Elle est possédée par un ancien Eon, Za-Noran, par l'intermédiaire de son cristal. Les tortues décident de détruire la pierre pour sauver leur amie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Quand Tokka décide de récupérer son petit, c'est le branle-bas de combat sur Terre. Les Forces de Protection Terriennes décident d'attaquer malgré les mises en garde de Bishop.
programme.sub-title: Tokka contre le reste du monde

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Tiger Claw et sa sœur Alopex ont été enlevés enfants par les Krangs. Le tigre et la renarde sont devenus ennemis. Alopex vole les lames de la vengeance dans un musée pour détruire son frère.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Super Shredder teste un nouveau super mutagène concocté par Stockman-mouche, qui se révèle parfait pour sa prochaine mission : exterminer tous ses ennemis sans exception, et sans empathie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues rendent visite à Karaï à l'hôpital. Elle leur révèle où se trouve la planque de Super Shredder. Il s'agit d'une forteresse high-tech en pleine forêt, défendue par ses footbots et autres sergents.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues enquêtent sur une mystérieuse secte qui se réunit dans les égoûts. Tiger Claw a décidé de ressusciter Super Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Tiger Claw ordonne à Kavaxas de ramener Rahzar à la vie, ce qu'il parvient à faire. Il lui dit de reproduire ce prodige avec Shredder. Mais il lui manque un élément essentiel, le Kuro Kabuto.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Kavaxas a besoin du cœur de Shredder pour le ressusciter. C'est Don Vizioso qui s'en est emparé et qui le conserve dans une fiole. Les tortues et Tiger Claw vont tout faire pour le lui reprendre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Shredder prend le pouvoir et détruit le sceau. Kavaxas est libre, il ouvre le portail du Royaume des Ténèbres et les revenants déferlent sur Terre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Maître Splinter réunit ses quatre fils, pas encore adolescents. Il leur raconte en détail la genèse de leur histoire, et leurs débuts dans les rues hostiles de New York.
programme.sub-title: Il était une fois Splinter et les tortues...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Panique le soir d'Halloween : New York est envahi de vrais zombies, vampires et loups-garous. April et Casey sont contaminés.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues veulent tuer Dracula avant que Savanti ne s'en empare. Mais Raph est transformé en vampire et Savanti s'enfuit, emportant avec lui la momie, un loup-garou (le père d'Esméralda), Raph et Dracula.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja partent en Allemagne en 1818 pour tenter d'arrêter Savanti Roméro, qui veut engager Frankenstein dans son armée. Ils échouent mais grace à Reinette les tortues retournent dans le futur pour une dernière tentative.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: La ville de New York est envahie par des monstres en tous genres. Les tortues, aidées de Reinette, tentent de déjouer le plan de Savanti Romero et de Dracula.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Un vaisseau se dirige vers la Terre. Le lieutenant Iguissg'ba et le commandant Gazéwroka ont reçu l'ordre de prendre en chasse un mercenaire en cavale, K'Vathrak, qui n'est autre que le Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Mikey a pris une décharge électrique fatale. Dregg débarque sur la planète avec son vaisseau, les tortues tentent par tous les moyens de sauver le monde.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues pensent être parvenues à vaincre leurs anciens ennemis, mais elles vont vite s'apercevoir qu'un nouveau mal est à l'œuvre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: À la recherche du Kuro Kabuto, Karaï se prétend héritière légitime du Clan des Foot quand elle tombe nez à nez avec un vieux rival.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: L'animosité de Donatello envers Don Vizioso met la mission des tortues en péril.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues débarquent dans un monde féodal peuplé d'animaux anthropomorphes.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Après avoir échappé aux soldats de Sumo Kuma, les tortues doivent affronter les Tanukis, des créatures versatiles, et Joroguma, la terrible femme-araignée.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Il reste quelques étapes aux tortues, à Usagi et à Kintaro, avant de rallier le temple-palais du Bouddha Céleste. Mais prudence, l'emprise de Jei n'est jamais loin...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Une bombe de mutagène a ravagé la Terre. Dans ce futur post-apocalyptique, Raph et Donnie affrontent le Clan des Blaireaux Maraudeurs du Bitume.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Dans un futur post-apocalyptique, Donnie le robot, Raph et Mira partent à la recherche du Grand Booyakasha qui peut déchiffrer la carte qui mène à Oasis.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Raph met le cap sur Oasis, poursuivi par Maximus Kong. Le combat s'engage.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'apparition des tortues, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Splinter autorise enfin les tortues à remonter à la surface. Elles tentent de secourir une jeune fille mais s'aperçoivent qu'elles ne savent pas se battre en équipe.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'apparition des tortues, 2e partie
programme.desc: Les tortues apprennent qu'April et son père sont retenus prisonniers par les Krangs, de méchants extraterrestres déguisés en robots androïdes. Les tortues réussiront-elles à pénétrer dans le repaire de l'ennemi et à combattre en équipe ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Caractère de tortue
programme.desc: Raphael perd son sang-froid quand un vieux New-Yorkais fait une vidéo des Tortues Ninja en train de se battre contre les Krangs. Les tortues doivent mettre la main sur cette vidéo avant qu'elles ne tombent entre de mauvaises mains.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Nouvel ami, vieil ennemi

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: New lodges nearly break the family, but they learn that it's the animals which make Leopard's Den a success.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny needs an assistant but fails to see that she's right under his nose; Sarah finds out that she needs her mum.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Leopard's Den expands and DuPlessis becomes a grandfather after a close-call with an angry elephant.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Danny and Sarah let their past catch up with them, and Caroline and DuPlessis go shopping for lion-prey.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: A white lion brings mixed fortunes to the family and Rosie is asked the big question. Amy Kriel is the last person you expect in Africa.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: Caroline's sister Judith tries to help and the drought forces Danny to sell some of his animals. Will Rosie and Max get married?

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: The drought finally throws up a fire and the wedding turns into a firefight for everyone. The omens are bad.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes and the Trevanians have to decide what future lies ahead of them in these difficult times.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: It's a year since we left Leopard's Den and much has changed. The animal hospital has been rebuilt and is now up and running. It's a big day for all the family as Danny has been fighting for custody of Evan and today they will learn the judge's decision.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny and Evan's life on the run doesn't start well when Danny falls asleep at the wheel and drives into a ditch. They have to enlist a local farmer, Johann, to winch them out.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Danny is asked by the State Vet to help control an outbreak of rabies in the National Park. When Vanessa is concerned for the animals at Mara, Danny assures her it's a long way away and advises her to continue with business as usual.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: It's the day before Rosie's wedding. Danny is proud of his daughter and determined to feed her up now that she's eating for two. All the family are excited about the imminent return of Caroline, especially Du Plessis who can't wait to see his fiancé.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: Alice and Danny are called out by a farmer who's trapped an African Wild Dog. As they're even more endangered than cheetahs and much more vicious, Danny and Alice are amazed to see one up close.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: When Du Plessis instructs the family to be around for dinner, they are intrigued to hear he's planning a big announcement. However, he won't be drawn on details and tells them to be patient.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Alice and Danny are delighted when the Animal Hospital is given responsibility for the rescue and conservation of animals in the region – it's a big achievement after all their hard work.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny and Alice are concerned about a missing male giraffe but Du Plessis is confident he can find him. He's as good as his word but they're upset to discover Mara lions have killed the giraffe.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: The family frantically dig for Charlotte in the rubble, hoping that somehow she has survived. Rowan arrives and takes charge of the situation, directing them to be more methodical in their rescue efforts.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: Danny and Alice are enjoying being together but agree to keep their relationship under wraps for the moment. However, they're unaware Georgina has heard their every word!

programme.title: Victorious: Tori Gets Stuck
programme.desc: Tori Gets Stuck: Tori is excited when she gets cast as the lead in the school play, but she has to deal with her very unhappy understudy… Jade. Tori has to avoid Jade's constant sabotage so she can perform on opening night.

programme.desc: The kids take Sikowitz to the theater to celebrate his ten-year teaching anniversary, but the play's subject sends Sikowitz into a deep depression. Tori must cheer him up.

programme.desc: Tori notices some changes in her friend Andre, whose girlfriend seems to be overbearing and controlling. Meanwhile, Jade and Cat try to earn easy money dog-sitting in Beverly Hills.

programme.desc: Cat's favorite actress dies and she talks Tori and Jade into driving to the actress' house to hold a vigil. Meanwhile, Trina directs a play starring herself, with Beck, Andre, and Robbie.

programme.title: Victorious: Tori & Jade's Play Date
programme.desc: Tori and Jade play a married couple putting their acting abilities and uneasy friendship to the test. Meanwhile, Cat & Robbie start a service where they deliver bad news in a friendly way.

programme.title: Victorious: The Gorilla Club
programme.desc: In an effort to take more risks as an actress, Tori goes to an underground spot called "The Gorilla Club." Meanwhile, Andre and Robbie lose a very interesting bet to Jade.
